name: Shared infrastructure across claimants
description: Flags a claim when the same filing IP is associated with multiple claimants. Shared infrastructure is an investigative lead only and requires independent corroboration.
trigger_logic: Trigger when the filing IP appears on two or more claimant records.
evidence_required: Employer or identity verification when applicable
system_action: Increase investigation priority and surface related claims for review.
prohibited_action: Must not automatically determine fraud, suspend benefits, or submit a disposition.

name: Device fingerprint reuse
description: Flags reuse of the same device fingerprint across claimant records. Household or shared-device scenarios may be legitimate and must be corroborated.
trigger_logic: Trigger when one device fingerprint is associated with more than one claimant.
system_action: Increase investigation priority and surface related claimant records.
prohibited_action: Must not treat device reuse as standalone proof of fraud.

name: Filing geography mismatch
description: Flags material differences between claimant residence and filing network geography, including cross-state or cross-country mismatches.
trigger_logic: Trigger when filing IP geography materially differs from the claimant residence location.
evidence_required: Travel, VPN, relocation, or authorized-assistance context
system_action: Prioritize network-context review and surface interstate policy guidance when relevant.
prohibited_action: Must not infer fraud solely from IP geolocation.

name: Higher-risk network range
description: Flags a filing network that is identified in the demo data as a higher-risk range. This remains a lead requiring independent evidence.
trigger_logic: Trigger when the filing IP falls within a configured higher-risk network range.
prohibited_action: Must not automatically block, deny, or dispose a claim.

name: Sequential IP cluster
description: Flags claims associated with sequential or closely related filing IPs that may indicate coordinated activity.
trigger_logic: Trigger when related claims use filing IPs in a configured sequential cluster.
system_action: Surface related claims and relevant closed-case precedent for investigator review.
prohibited_action: Prior-case similarity must not substitute for evidence in the current claim.

name: Undeclared wage match
description: Flags wage evidence that overlaps a period in which benefits were claimed and the earnings may not have been reported.
trigger_logic: Trigger when wage records overlap claimed certification weeks and indicate potentially unreported earnings.
system_action: Prioritize earnings reconciliation and display the reporting-earnings policy.
prohibited_action: Must not issue an overpayment or fraud determination without human review of the evidence.

name: New-hire registry timing signal
description: Flags a timing relationship between a claim and new-hire registry information that may require employment-date verification.
trigger_logic: Trigger when a new-hire registry event falls within a configured review window around claimed weeks.
system_action: Surface employment-date verification as the next investigative step.
prohibited_action: Must not assume the registry date is the actual first day worked.
